bang.Cách rút: bỏ chủ ngữ + động từ → V-ing
bang.Ví dụ: *Because it lacks funding, the project stalled.* → **Lacking funding**, the project stalled.
*When it is built, the metro will…* → **Once built**, the metro will…
*After he had finished, he left.* → **Having finished**, he left.

doan_van.noi_dung: Working from home offers significant flexibility for modern employees. Considering the benefits of a remote environment, many professionals prefer skipping daily commutes to save valuable time. Having finished his morning tasks, Minh reorganises his cluttered workspace to increase productivity. Surrounded by piles of documents, he feels overwhelmed by the growing workload. Striving for better organisation, he decides to digitise every paper file immediately. This change transforms his messy desk into a clean and efficient station. Feeling relieved after this process, he completes his remaining projects much faster. His efficiency improves because he eliminates the physical chaos surrounding his work area.

Attempting to jump over the water, he misjudges the distance completely. He lands squarely in the centre of the mess, soaking his trousers. Feeling utterly embarrassed, he hides behind a nearby tree. Realising the letter is now ruined, he returns home feeling defeated. Having experienced such bad luck, he decides to order his mail collection online from now on.

doan_van.ten: Mini-story - Mệnh đề rút gọn trong giao tiếp
doan_van.noi_dung: Academic discourse often benefits from the concise nature of participle clauses. Utilizing these structures enhances clarity by reducing redundancy in written communication. First, participle clauses allow writers to combine related ideas efficiently within a single sentence. This consolidation improves the logical flow and cohesion of an argument. Second, these constructions provide a sophisticated tone suitable for professional settings. By omitting unnecessary subjects, the text becomes more direct and authoritative. Consider a scenario where Nam meets a colleague at a conference. Walking towards the reception desk, he notices a familiar face. Feeling surprised, he approaches his former classmate to initiate a brief conversation. He asks about her recent project while sharing his own professional updates. Initially hesitant to engage in small talk, the colleague becomes increasingly enthusiastic about the topic. She describes her current research, appearing confident and well-prepared. Their interaction transitions from a formal greeting into a meaningful exchange of ideas. The conversation shifts their professional relationship from acquaintances to potential collaborators. phat_am:
- Mệnh đề rút gọn trong nói cần **ngắt hơi nhẹ** sau nó: *Having finished the report, (ngắt) she went home.*
- **Faced** /feɪst/ — đuôi /t/.
- **Given** /ˈɡɪvn/ — 2 âm tiết.
luu_y:
**① Chủ ngữ của mệnh đề rút gọn PHẢI trùng với chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính.** Không trùng thì thành lỗi “dangling participle”:

- ❌ *Walking down the street, the building looked impressive.* (tòa nhà đang đi bộ?)
- ✅ *Walking down the street, **I** thought the building looked impressive.*

> Đây là lỗi nghiêm trọng, sửa bằng cách kiểm tra: **ai đang làm hành động V-ing?**

**② Chủ động dùng V-ing, bị động dùng V3 — chọn sai là đảo nghĩa:**

- *The student **teaching** the class* = sinh viên đang dạy
- *The student **taught** by Mr. Nam* = sinh viên được dạy

**③ Having + V3 chỉ dùng khi hành động xảy ra TRƯỚC hành động chính:**
✅ **Having completed** the course, she applied for a job.
❌ Having completed the course, she is studying now. *(sai logic thời gian)*

**④ Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ được khi đại từ quan hệ là CHỦ NGỮ:**
✅ The report **which was published** → the report **published**
❌ The report **which I read** → không rút gọn được (which là tân ngữ)

**⑤ Đừng rút gọn quá nhiều.** Ba mệnh đề rút gọn liên tiếp làm câu khó theo dõi. Xen câu bình thường.

**⑥ Một số cụm rút gọn cố định cần thuộc:**
Faced with… · Based on… · Compared with… · Given that… · Depending on… · Regarding… · According to…
meo:
- Rút gọn nhớ 3 dạng bằng 3 câu hỏi: **Chủ động? → V-ing · Bị động? → V3 · Xảy ra trước? → Having V3.**
- Kiểm tra dangling participle bằng câu hỏi: **“Ai đang V-ing?”** Nếu câu trả lời không phải chủ ngữ chính thì sai.
- Học 7 cụm cố định ở mục ⑥ — chúng dùng được ngay mà không cần hiểu sâu ngữ pháp.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Mệnh đề rút gọn trong cuộc sống
mini_story.truyen: Working from home offers significant flexibility for modern employees. Considering the benefits of a remote environment, many professionals prefer skipping daily commutes to save valuable time. Having finished his morning tasks, Minh reorganises his cluttered workspace to increase productivity. Surrounded by piles of documents, he feels overwhelmed by the growing workload. Striving for better organisation, he decides to digitise every paper file immediately. This change transforms his messy desk into a clean and efficient station. Feeling relieved after this process, he completes his remaining projects much faster. His efficiency improves because he eliminates the physical chaos surrounding his work area.

mini_story.truyen: Minh leaves his apartment to post a letter at the local office. Walking briskly along the sidewalk, he notices a large puddle blocking his path. Attempting to jump over the water, he misjudges the distance completely. He lands squarely in the centre of the mess, soaking his trousers. Feeling utterly embarrassed, he hides behind a nearby tree. Realising the letter is now ruined, he returns home feeling defeated. Having experienced such bad luck, he decides to order his mail collection online from now on.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Mệnh đề rút gọn trong giao tiếp
mini_story.truyen: Academic discourse often benefits from the concise nature of participle clauses. Utilizing these structures enhances clarity by reducing redundancy in written communication. First, participle clauses allow writers to combine related ideas efficiently within a single sentence. This consolidation improves the logical flow and cohesion of an argument. Second, these constructions provide a sophisticated tone suitable for professional settings. By omitting unnecessary subjects, the text becomes more direct and authoritative. Consider a scenario where Nam meets a colleague at a conference. Walking towards the reception desk, he notices a familiar face. Feeling surprised, he approaches his former classmate to initiate a brief conversation. He asks about her recent project while sharing his own professional updates. Initially hesitant to engage in small talk, the colleague becomes increasingly enthusiastic about the topic. She describes her current research, appearing confident and well-prepared. Their interaction transitions from a formal greeting into a meaningful exchange of ideas. The conversation shifts their professional relationship from acquaintances to potential collaborators. This brief encounter demonstrates how effective communication builds connections between individuals in any academic or workplace environment.
